ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT of the 1m day of r 2026,by and betweenSlope AvenueAssociation LLC, having an address at c/o Jeans Management LLC, 29-15 23rd Avenue Astoria, NY 11105 ("Owner"), and 520-522 4th Avenue LLC, having an address at 1548 E 2nd Street, Brooklyn, NY 11230 ("Developer") (Owner and Developer are sometimes hereinafter collectively referred to as the "Parties"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Owner is the owner in fee of certain land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, located in the Borough of Brooklyn and County of Kings, City and State of New York, being Lot 37 in Block 1033 on the Tax Map of the City of New York,as more particularly described in Exhibit A annexed hereto and made a part hereof (the “Owner Land"; the buildings and improvements located thereon or which may be located thereon in the future are herein referred to as the “Owner Building"; and the Owner Land and the Owner Building are herein collectively referred to as the “Owner Parcel"); WHEREAS, Developer is the owner in fee of certain land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, located in the Borough of Brooklyn and County of Kings, City and State of New York, being Lot 40 in Block 1033 on the Tax Map of the City of New York,as more particularly described in Exhibit B annexed hereto and made a part hereof (the “Developer Land", said building and improvements, together with any future replacements thereof permitted in accordance with this Agreement, being herein collectively called the “Developer Building,” and the Developer Land and the Developer Building being herein collectively called the“Developer Parcel"); WHEREAS, Owner Parcel, and Developer Parcel, together with the premises known as Block 1033, Lot 39 (the“Lot 39 Parcel") and one or more Additional Parcels (as herein defined), will comprise a single zoning lot that will be contiguous with Purchaser Parcel for a distanceofatleast10linearfeet. WHEREAS, Developer intends to construct one or more new buildings on all or a portion of the Developer Land and, subject to a separate Zoning Lot Development and Easement Agreement between the owner of the Lot 39 Parcel and Developer, cantilever over a portion of the Lot 39 Parcel (each, a “New Developer Building"), with a bulk that would be in excess of the bulk permitted to be constructed on Developer Land under the Zoning Resolution (as hereinafter defined), if the Developer Land was considered as a separate and independent zoning lot; WHEREAS, there are certain “Development Rights”(as hereinafter defined) appurtenant to the Owner Land that are in excess of the “Retained Development Rights" (as hereinafter defined) and that are available for transfer in accordance with the Zoning Resolution; 2
